Upcoming hooks (only official documents are new): Dublin informal European Council 11-13; CCW 7th Review Conference on autonomous weapons in Geneva 11-16..20; House closed briefing with Nvidia's Jensen Huang 11-18; lame-duck Congress mid-November (NDAA AI provisions, chip-security bills); Meta's AI-scraping commercial terms take effect 11-20 (Norway and Brazil courts suspended them; UK CMA probe open); Delhi HC Kriti Sanon hearing 12-10.
